title: How Nikolay Storonsky Built a $45B+ Fintech Empire
description:
Most fintechs die trying to fit into a system designed to keep them out.

Revolut took the opposite approach: It scaled by ignoring convention, challenging legacy banking models, and building its systems from the ground up.

Nikolay Storonsky, CEO and Co-founder of Revolut, shares with us two fundamental truths: systems can be hacked, and endurance beats talent.

This mindset shaped Revolut, which went from a niche FX product to a global financial super app, challenging banks at their own game.

In this conversation, we unpack:
• why Nik stopped relying on VCs, even after raising $2 billion,
• how Revolut scaled past regulators and legacy banks, and
• why blitzscaling isn’t enough when margins are thin and compliance costs are high.
